Container.Name: HA-Learning-Thermostat
Container.Overview: An intelligent, tabular reinforcement learning thermostat that integrates natively with Home Assistant. It optimizes heating/cooling schedules based on external ambient conditions, pricing constraints, and air quality metrics while forgiving manual human intervention.
Container.Description: An intelligent, tabular reinforcement learning thermostat that integrates natively with Home Assistant. It optimizes heating/cooling schedules based on external ambient conditions, pricing constraints, and air quality metrics while forgiving manual human intervention.

Variable.Name: HA_ADD
Variable.Description: The IP/Port address of your Home Assistant instance (e.g., 192.168.1.50:8123).

Variable.Name: HA_TOKEN
Variable.Description: Your Long-Lived Access Token generated from your Home Assistant profile page.

Variable.Name: THERMOSTAT_ENTITY_ID
Variable.Description: The Home Assistant climate domain entity tracking target controls.

Variable.Name: IP
Variable.Description: The host bind address for the internal backend server.

Variable.Name: PORT
Variable.Description: Internal binding port for the interactive UI matrix.

Variable.Name: COOLING_ENERGY_USAGE_SENSOR
Variable.Description: Energy consumption entity identifier tracking kilowatt metrics.

Variable.Name: OUTSIDE_TEMP_SENSOR
Variable.Description: External outdoor temperature tracking entity identifier.

Variable.Name: OUTSIDE_HUMD_SENSOR
Variable.Description: External outdoor humidity tracking entity identifier.

Variable.Name: SAFETY_MIN
Variable.Description: Minimum safety clamp floor allowed by reinforcement agent operations.

Variable.Name: SAFETY_MAX
Variable.Description: Maximum safety clamp ceiling allowed by reinforcement agent operations.

Variable.Name: ENABLE_AQ_FEATURE
Variable.Description: Toggle environment flag parameter enabling ventilation routines (True/False).

Variable.Name: SWAMP_COOLER_ENTITY_ID
Variable.Description: Home assistant switch selector managing physical air hardware devices.

Variable.Name: AQ_VOC_SENSOR
Variable.Description: Volatile organic compound input hardware metrics index tracking.

Variable.Name: AQ_VOC_THRESHOLD
Variable.Description: Air quality trigger points enforcing environmental safety actions.

Variable.Name: AQ_VOC_CLEAN_THRESHOLD
Variable.Description: Air quality recovery clearance parameters shutting down manual vent routines.
